**Finding submitted: deviation (IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).**

- **Issue:** Section 13 (p0088) declares Garman the owner of all IP in the Work "including any Improvements or Modifications thereto" and "all related materials... provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement", with no title passing to us. The Schedule "D" Modifications are bespoke changes we commission and pay for, yet there is no licence-back beyond the narrow non-transferable object-code licence in Section 2, and nothing anywhere in the agreement confirms that our data (including data converted under Section 4(b)) and our supplied materials remain ours — the "all related materials" sweep-up arguably reaches our own inputs.
- **Position taken:** Fallback, because the deal is an object-code licence to Garman's platform backed by source-code escrow (Section 16), so demanding assignment of the Modifications would be disproportionate.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** (i) limit the ownership sentence to materials provided *by Garman* and subject it to the licences granted to us; (ii) add a new paragraph confirming we retain all rights in our data and materials, granting us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use and modify the Modifications and Improvements across our and our affiliates' business, and excluding joint ownership.
